comparison.objective: Assemble two spacer halves around a captive shaft; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual part alignment and enclosure around an obstruction versus counterholding, hex-key use, collar rotation, tightening, and cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Both spacer seams within 4 mm versus dynamic stopping and post-lock drift thresholds.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual stabilization is generic; split-part assembly and adjustable damping are different tested abilities.
